changes: New: Vellum Draw — Vellum has a new name, a new icon and a new startup card. Your drawings, settings and MCP setup carry over.

New: Assistant — a chat pane on the right edge (Ctrl+L): Claude Code, Codex, or your own API key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama). Paste a picture and watch it draw; every answer is one Undo.
New: Light or dark from the status bar — a sun/moon button at its right end.
New: Donate — a button beside the tabs (Ko-fi); close it with its x, Help keeps the link.
Fix: The status bar names only the file, so the page tabs keep their room.
